organization_note: Liquid AI, Inc., whose privacy policy gives its address as 314 Main Street, Cambridge, Massachusetts, and whose terms of service are governed by Massachusetts law, develops and publishes the Liquid Foundation Models; it states that it does not offer a hosted API of its own, so no other catalog name reaches it and OpenRouter's route to the same weights belongs to that operator, not to this lab. Its company page says it was spun out of MIT CSAIL in 2023 by Ramin Hasani, Mathias Lechner, Alexander Amini, and Daniela Rus, and that MIT is its origin rather than a parent it reports. The verified GitHub organization is Liquid4All, linked from liquid.ai, and the weights are published under the LiquidAI Hugging Face organization; the unrelated github.com/LiquidAI account, which is registered to an individual in Cleveland and publishes three forked tutorial repositories, is not this lab's.
